name: Young Adult Volunteers (Summer Learning Program)
what_you_do: You help the library with its Summer Learning Program. You do many small library tasks.
who_can_apply: Students entering grades 6 to 12 in the 2026-27 school year. You must live in Livermore. Each applicant needs a separate account and email.
pay_detail: Volunteer. The program page does not mention community service hours.
deadline_text: The program page lists an application deadline of April 13, 2025. That date is before the 2026 program, so the real deadline is unclear. The page does not give a next deadline or the next summer's dates.
how_to_apply: Click Fill in an application on the volunteer page. If you already have an account on the library volunteer portal, log in. You must go to an orientation and log your hours in your account.
notes: The program page does not give start and end dates, orientation details or the number of hours. Ask the library before you apply. The listing is for summer 2026, so look for the next summer posting.
